title: Setting of the contents of MBS Interest Indication

entities.name: MBS Interest Indication
entities.description: Message sent by UE to indicate interest in MBS frequencies and services.

entities.name: mbs-FreqList
entities.description: Information element containing MBS frequencies of interest sorted by decreasing order of interest.

entities.name: mbs-Priority
entities.description: Information element indicating UE prioritizes MBS reception above unicast bearers and multicast MRBs.

entities.name: mbs-ServiceList
entities.description: Information element indicating set of MBS services of interest sorted by decreasing order of interest.

entities.name: MBS frequencies of interest not empty
entities.description: Condition where the set of MBS frequencies of interest determined according to 5.9.4.3 is not empty.

entities.name: UE prioritizes MBS reception
entities.description: Condition where UE prioritizes reception of all indicated MBS frequencies above unicast bearers and multicast MRBs.

entities.name: SIB20 scheduled by PCell
entities.description: Condition where SIB20 is scheduled by the PCell.

relations.description: MBS Interest Indication includes mbs-FreqList when MBS frequencies of interest are not empty.
MBS Interest Indication includes mbs-Priority when UE prioritizes MBS reception.
MBS Interest Indication includes mbs-ServiceList when SIB20 is scheduled by PCell.
Inclusion of mbs-FreqList is guarded by condition that MBS frequencies of interest are not empty.
Inclusion of mbs-Priority is guarded by condition that UE prioritizes MBS reception.
Inclusion of mbs-ServiceList is guarded by condition that SIB20 is scheduled by PCell.
